summary: Learn the importance of ethics in business with our Corporate Ethics and Integrity Management Training Course. Build a culture of integrity and trust today.
lede: Integrity training helps ethics, compliance, audit, and investigations professionals assess conduct risks and strengthen integrity controls across business operations. Participants practise building ethics risk registers, designing speak-up and investigation workflows, and assessing third-party integrity controls. The course also covers control testing and ethics metrics to help teams evaluate whether controls are operating and report findings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage conduct, compliance, investigations, assurance, and integrity controls across business operations. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with policies, risk information, employee concerns, or audit evidence and need a more integrated operating approach.
prerequisites: Working experience in compliance, ethics, internal audit, investigations, human resources, legal operations, risk, or governance is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing policies, basic risk information, and operational evidence. No coding or programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted monitoring are covered at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering level. Bring a current ethics policy, risk register, or anonymized control example if available. Do not bring confidential personal data or live investigation records.
